name: Altech PS-C120xx compact supply housing
summary: Compact power-supply housing reference for PS-C12012, PS-C12024 and PS-C12048.
description: Coordinate the compact supply with adjacent terminal blocks and wire duct. Leave access to the terminals even where the housing fits closely between devices.
The downloadable GA illustration is independently authored conceptual geometry, with no scale or manufacturer dimensions. Use the official CAD source for the exact layout.
Altech originals remain at the manufacturer source because their drawing notices restrict reproduction. Product lifecycle and availability have not been established.
readingNotes: Use the shared housing drawing only after identifying the installed output-voltage variant.
Compact mechanical fit does not establish permissible side-by-side thermal loading.
